title: Canadian veteran wants to die by euthanasia because of how VA treats him
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — A Canadian military veteran has become so despondent and unsatisfied with how he is being treated by the nation’s Veterans Affairs (VA) that he now wants to die by euthanasia. The veteran said that he has asked to die by Medical Assistance in Dying (MAID) because he can no longer handle the “nightmare” of dealing with Canada’s VA. … Canada’s liberal euthanasia laws have made the practice so commonplace that a Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) veteran said she has “proof” that no fewer than 20 of her colleagues were offered unsolicited state-sponsored euthanasia. As reported by LifeSiteNews, this is not the first report of CAF veterans saying they were offered MAID. It was revealed last year that the VA appears to have purposefully stopped the publication of a paper after scandalous allegations surfaced of caseworkers recommending euthanasia to suffering service members.
